# NYC.gov - New York City Government

> NYC.gov is the official portal for New York City government services, enabling residents to access public assistance, file complaints, pay bills, and navigate city agencies through integrated digital platforms.

NYC.gov serves as the primary digital hub for NYC residents and businesses to interact with city government, featuring the NYC311 service request system, ACCESS NYC benefits screening, and comprehensive guides from departments like DSNY, HPD, and the Department of Health. The site aggregates services across multiple city agencies to provide centralized access to essential municipal services.

## Key Topics

- NYC311 - Service request and complaint reporting portal
- ACCESS NYC - Public assistance eligibility screening
- DSNY - Sanitation and waste management
- HPD - Housing and building compliance
- Department of Health - Vital records and public health
- NYC Mayor's Office - Executive announcements
- Service requests and complaint filing
- Public assistance programs
- Civic services and government information
- Tenant rights and housing regulations
- Tax preparation assistance
- School enrollment and education services
- 311 reporting system
- City alerts and news updates

## Core Government Portals

- [Official Website of New York City Government - nyc.gov](https://www.nyc.gov/main): NYC government homepage with parking, schools, trash collection status and popular services
- [NYC311 Portal Home](https://portal.311.nyc.gov): NYC311 portal homepage for service requests, complaints, and public assistance
- [ACCESS NYC Eligibility Screener](https://access.nyc.gov/eligibility): Interactive tool to screen eligibility for NYC public assistance programs
- [NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office): Mayor's Office official site with announcements, news, and city government information

## Service Requests and Complaints

- [Report Problems via NYC311](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/report-problems): NYC311 portal for filing complaints and service requests across city agencies
- [Look Up Service Requests](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/check-status): NYC311 tool to track and check status of submitted service requests
- [NYC311 Service Information](https://portal.311.nyc.gov/article): NYC311 service request article page with mobile app information

## Government Services Directory

- [NYC Government Services](https://www.nyc.gov/main/services): Directory of NYC government services including benefits, complaints, housing, and business services

## Housing, Utilities, and Sanitation

- [Heat and Hot Water Information - HPD](https://www.nyc.gov/site/hpd/services-and-information/heat-and-hot-water-information.page): HPD guide to tenant rights, building compliance, and heat/hot water regulations
- [Get Rid of... Waste Disposal Guide - DSNY](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dsny/collection/get-rid-of.page): DSNY guide for waste disposal, recycling, and hazardous materials management

## Vital Records, Education, and Financial Services

- [Birth Certificates - NYC Health](https://www.nyc.gov/site/doh/services/birth-death-records-birth.page): NYC Health guide to ordering birth certificates via VitalChek
- [Summer Rising Program Enrollment](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/enrollment/summer-rising): NYC Department of Education guide to Summer Rising program enrollment for K-8 students
- [Free Tax Prep - DCWP](https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/talk-money/file-your-taxes.page): DCWP guide to NYC Free Tax Prep program for IRS-certified tax filing assistance
